name: Vector display
summary: A cathode-ray tube whose beam draws straight lines from point to point, not a raster of pixels. Lines are sharp at any angle and glow on a black ground.
how: Draw each object as a list of line segments; keep a whole frame under a few thousand segments.
Keep the ground black; only the lines emit light.
Use full beam brightness for the player and half for the background.

origin.note: Spacewar! runs on the point-plotting display of the PDP-1.

adoptions.via: Atari ships Asteroids and Lunar Lander on vector monitors in arcades.
